sentences.text: 上个星期我和妻子去了北京。
sentences.en: Last week my wife and I went to Beijing.

sentences.text: 我们是坐飞机去的。
sentences.en: We went by plane.

sentences.text: 北京比我们的城市大很多。
sentences.en: Beijing is much bigger than our city.

sentences.text: 第一天，我们去看了天安门。
sentences.en: On the first day, we went to see Tiananmen.

sentences.text: 那天天气很好，不冷也不热。
sentences.en: The weather was very nice that day, neither cold nor hot.

sentences.text: 晚上我们吃了北京烤鸭。
sentences.en: In the evening we ate Peking roast duck.

sentences.text: 我以前没吃过烤鸭，我觉得非常好吃。
sentences.en: I had never eaten roast duck before, and I thought it was delicious.

sentences.text: 因为人太多了，所以我们每天都很累。
sentences.en: Because there were too many people, we were tired every day.

sentences.text: 可是我们都很高兴。
sentences.en: But we were both very happy.

sentences.text: 明年我们还想再去一次。
sentences.en: Next year we want to go again.

questions.q: How did they travel to Beijing?
What did they eat in the evening?
Why were they tired every day?

sentences.text: 今天是王方的生日。
sentences.en: Today is Wang Fang's birthday.

sentences.text: 她今年二十岁了。
sentences.en: She turned twenty this year.

sentences.text: 早上，妈妈给她做了面条。
sentences.en: In the morning, her mom made noodles for her.

sentences.text: 下午，她的朋友们来她家了。
sentences.en: In the afternoon, her friends came to her home.

sentences.text: 他们送了她很多礼物。
sentences.en: They gave her many gifts.
tokens: to give (as a gift); to deliver

sentences.text: 小李送的是一本书，大卫送的是一件红色的衣服。
sentences.en: Xiao Li gave a book, and David gave a piece of red clothing.
tokens: to give (as a gift); to deliver
to give (as a gift); to deliver

sentences.text: 王方最喜欢那件衣服。
sentences.en: Wang Fang liked that piece of clothing the most.

sentences.text: 晚上，大家一起吃蛋糕，唱歌。
sentences.en: In the evening, everyone ate cake and sang together.

sentences.text: 王方笑着说：“谢谢你们，今天我非常快乐！”
sentences.en: Wang Fang said with a smile: "Thank you all, I'm very happy today!"

questions.q: How old is Wang Fang this year?
What did David give her?
What did her mom make in the morning?

sentences.text: 昨天晚上，小明觉得身体不舒服。
sentences.en: Last night, Xiao Ming didn't feel well.

sentences.text: 今天早上他发烧了，头也很疼。
sentences.en: This morning he had a fever, and his head hurt too.

sentences.text: 他给老师打电话说：“老师，我生病了，今天不能去学校。”
sentences.en: He called his teacher and said: "Teacher, I'm sick, I can't go to school today."

sentences.text: 妈妈带他去了医院。
sentences.en: His mom took him to the hospital.

sentences.text: 医生说：“你感冒了，要多喝水，多休息。”
sentences.en: The doctor said: "You have a cold. You should drink more water and rest more."

sentences.text: 医生还给了他一些药。
sentences.en: The doctor also gave him some medicine.

sentences.text: 因为药很苦，所以小明不想吃。
sentences.en: Because the medicine was very bitter, Xiao Ming didn't want to take it.

sentences.text: 妈妈说：“不吃药，病不会好。”
sentences.en: His mom said: "If you don't take the medicine, you won't get better."

sentences.text: 三天以后，小明的病好了，他又去上课了。
sentences.en: Three days later, Xiao Ming was better, and he went to class again.

questions.q: What did the doctor say was wrong?
Who took Xiao Ming to the hospital?
How long until he was better?

sentences.text: 李静找到了一个新工作。
sentences.en: Li Jing found a new job.

sentences.text: 她在一家公司工作，公司离她家不远。
sentences.en: She works at a company that isn't far from her home.

sentences.text: 每天早上她七点起床，走路去公司。
sentences.en: Every morning she gets up at seven and walks to the company.

sentences.text: 第一天上班，她很早就到了。
sentences.en: On her first day at work, she arrived very early.

sentences.text: 公司里的人都很好，常常帮助她。
sentences.en: The people at the company are all very nice and often help her.

sentences.text: 这个工作比她以前的工作忙，可是也更有意思。
sentences.en: This job is busier than her old job, but it's also more interesting.

sentences.text: 中午，她和同事一起去吃饭。
sentences.en: At noon, she goes to eat with her colleagues.

sentences.text: 下班以后，她还要学习英语，因为公司里有很多外国客人。
sentences.en: After work, she also has to study English, because the company has many foreign clients.

sentences.text: 她觉得自己的英语说得还不太好。
sentences.en: She feels her spoken English is not very good yet.

sentences.text: 她希望明年能说得更好。
sentences.en: She hopes she can speak it better next year.

questions.q: How does Li Jing get to work?
Why does she study English?
options: The company has many foreign clients

questions.q: How is the new job compared to her old one?

sentences.text: 大卫很喜欢运动。
sentences.en: David really likes sports.

sentences.text: 他每个星期六都和同学们去打篮球。
sentences.en: Every Saturday he goes to play basketball with his classmates.

sentences.text: 他打得比别人好，因为他从小就开始打了。
sentences.en: He plays better than the others, because he started playing as a child.

sentences.text: 上个月，学校有一个篮球比赛。
sentences.en: Last month, the school had a basketball match.

sentences.text: 大卫和他的朋友们都参加了。
sentences.en: David and his friends all took part.

sentences.text: 比赛那天，来看的人非常多。
sentences.en: On the day of the match, a lot of people came to watch.

sentences.text: 开始的时候，他们打得不太好。
sentences.en: At the beginning, they didn't play very well.

sentences.text: 后来，大卫跑得很快，进了很多球。
sentences.en: Later, David ran very fast and scored many baskets.

sentences.text: 最后，他们赢了！
sentences.en: In the end, they won!

sentences.text: 大家都很高兴，晚上一起去饭馆吃了饭。
sentences.en: Everyone was very happy, and in the evening they went to a restaurant together for dinner.

questions.q: When does David usually play basketball?
Why does David play better than the others?
What happened at the end of the match?

sentences.text: 昨天下午，张老师坐出租车去商店买东西。
sentences.en: Yesterday afternoon, Teacher Zhang took a taxi to a shop to buy things.

sentences.text: 下车以后，她发现手机不见了。
sentences.en: After getting out of the car, she discovered her phone was missing.
tokens: to get out of a vehicle

sentences.text: 她非常着急，因为手机里有很多重要的东西。
sentences.en: She was very worried, because there were many important things on the phone.

sentences.text: 她找了很长时间，可是没找到。
sentences.en: She looked for a long time, but didn't find it.

sentences.text: 她想：手机可能在出租车上。
sentences.en: She thought: maybe the phone is in the taxi.

sentences.text: 她用商店的电话给自己的手机打了一个电话。
sentences.en: She used the shop's phone to call her own phone.

sentences.text: 一个男人接了电话，他就是那个出租车司机。
sentences.en: A man answered the phone; he was the taxi driver.

sentences.text: 司机说：“别担心，我马上给您送过去。”
sentences.en: The driver said: "Don't worry, I'll bring it over to you right away."

sentences.text: 十分钟以后，司机来了，张老师拿到了手机。
sentences.en: Ten minutes later, the driver came, and Teacher Zhang got her phone back.

sentences.text: 她说：“太谢谢你了，你真是一个好人！”
sentences.en: She said: "Thank you so much, you are really a good person!"

questions.q: How did Teacher Zhang go to the shop?
Where was the phone?
Who answered the phone call?

sentences.text: 上个月，我和爸爸妈妈去了奶奶家。
sentences.en: Last month, my mom, dad and I went to Grandma's home.

sentences.text: 奶奶住在农村，离城市很远。
sentences.en: Grandma lives in the countryside, far from the city.

sentences.text: 我们开了四个小时的车才到。
sentences.en: We drove for four hours before we arrived.

sentences.text: 奶奶家的房子不大，可是很干净。
sentences.en: Grandma's house isn't big, but it's very clean.

sentences.text: 房子后面有一条小河，河里有很多鱼。
sentences.en: Behind the house there is a small river with lots of fish in it.

sentences.text: 下午，爷爷带我去河边钓鱼。
sentences.en: In the afternoon, Grandpa took me fishing by the river.

sentences.text: 我以前没有钓过鱼，觉得很有意思。
sentences.en: I had never fished before, and I thought it was very interesting.

sentences.text: 我们钓了三条鱼，晚上奶奶给我们做了鱼。
sentences.en: We caught three fish, and in the evening Grandma cooked the fish for us.

sentences.text: 农村的空气比城市的好多了，晚上还能看到很多星星。
sentences.en: The air in the countryside is much better than in the city, and at night you can see many stars.

sentences.text: 我真不想回家！
sentences.en: I really didn't want to go home!

questions.q: How long did the drive take?
How many fish did they catch?
What is better in the countryside than in the city?

sentences.text: 安娜是美国人，她去年来到了中国。
sentences.en: Anna is American; she came to China last year.

sentences.text: 她刚来的时候，一句汉语也不会说。
sentences.en: When she first arrived, she couldn't speak a single sentence of Chinese.

sentences.text: 买东西、坐车、吃饭都很难。
sentences.en: Buying things, taking buses, and eating out were all very difficult.

sentences.text: 所以她开始在大学学习汉语。
sentences.en: So she began studying Chinese at a university.

sentences.text: 她的老师姓王，王老师上课非常有意思。
sentences.en: Her teacher's surname is Wang, and Teacher Wang's classes are very interesting.

sentences.text: 安娜每天都学习两个小时，还常常和中国朋友聊天。
sentences.en: Anna studies for two hours every day and often chats with Chinese friends.

sentences.text: 现在，她的汉语比以前好多了。
sentences.en: Now her Chinese is much better than before.

sentences.text: 她会说很多话，也会写一些汉字。
sentences.en: She can say a lot, and can also write some Chinese characters.

sentences.text: 上个星期，她一个人去饭馆点了菜。
sentences.en: Last week, she went to a restaurant alone and ordered food.

sentences.text: 服务员说：“你的汉语说得真好！”
sentences.en: The waiter said: "Your Chinese is really good!"

questions.q: Where is Anna from?
How long does Anna study every day?
What is her teacher's surname?
